test_cases.description: WorkspaceConfig struct exists with Path and Workers fields and is embedded in Config as Workspace with correct TOML tags.
preconditions: apikit config package source is available
Go toolchain is installed
test_cases.input: Inspect the Config and WorkspaceConfig type definitions in the apikit config package

expected.Config.Workspace: field of type WorkspaceConfig with toml tag "workspace"
expected.WorkspaceConfig: struct with fields Path string (toml:"path") and Workers int (toml:"workers")

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: cfg_type = reflect(Config); assert cfg_type has field 'Workspace' of type WorkspaceConfig with toml tag 'workspace'; ws_type = reflect(WorkspaceConfig); assert ws_type has field 'Path' of type string with toml tag 'path'; assert ws_type has field 'Workers' of type int with toml tag 'workers'

test_cases.description: Load() resolves Workspace.Path via resolveDataPath and defaults Workers to 4 when configured value is 0.
preconditions: config.toml is written with [workspace] path = "./workspace" and workers = 0
apikit config package is available
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: cfg, err = Load(); assert err == nil; assert cfg.Workspace.Path == './workspace'; assert cfg.Workspace.Workers == 4

test_cases.description: Load() sets Workspace.Path to './workspace' and Workers to 4 when config.toml specifies those exact values.
preconditions: config.toml contains [workspace] path = "./workspace" and workers = 4
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: cfg, err = Load(); assert err == nil; assert cfg.Workspace.Path == './workspace'; assert cfg.Workspace.Workers == 4

test_cases.description: Load() applies empty-path resolution rules and defaults Workers to 4 when the [workspace] section is entirely omitted from config.toml.
preconditions: config.toml does not contain a [workspace] section
XDG_DATA_HOME environment variable is unset
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: unset_env('XDG_DATA_HOME'); cfg, err = Load(); assert err == nil; assert cfg.Workspace.Workers == 4; assert cfg.Workspace.Path == './data/workspaces'

test_cases.description: Server boot creates the WORKSPACE_ROOT directory (including missing parents) when it does not already exist.
preconditions: WORKSPACE_ROOT directory does not exist on the filesystem
hub server binary is available
config.toml points Workspace.Path to a non-existent directory
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: remove_dir_if_exists('/tmp/test-ws-root-new'); start_server(config); assert dir_exists('/tmp/test-ws-root-new') == true; assert server_is_running() == true

test_cases.description: Server exits with a non-zero exit code and logs a fatal error when WORKSPACE_ROOT cannot be created due to insufficient permissions.
preconditions: A parent directory exists with permissions 000 (no write access)
config.toml points Workspace.Path to a subdirectory of that unwritable parent

expected.log_output: contains fatal error message about workspace directory creation failure

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: create_unwritable_dir('/tmp/no-perm'); cfg.Workspace.Path = '/tmp/no-perm/workspaces'; result = start_server_and_wait(cfg); assert result.exit_code != 0; assert result.stderr contains 'fatal' or result.log contains 'fatal'

test_cases.description: The workspaces SQLite table includes clone_status (TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'), head_sha (TEXT nullable), and clone_error (TEXT nullable) columns.
preconditions: SQLite database is initialized with the workspaces table DDL from this spec
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: db = open_sqlite(db_path); cols = db.query('PRAGMA table_info(workspaces)'); clone_status_col = find_col(cols, 'clone_status'); assert clone_status_col.type == 'TEXT'; assert clone_status_col.notnull == 1; assert clone_status_col.dflt_value == "'pending'"; head_sha_col = find_col(cols, 'head_sha'); assert head_sha_col.notnull == 0; clone_error_col = find_col(cols, 'clone_error'); assert clone_error_col.notnull == 0

test_cases.description: All workspace API endpoints (create, list, get, update, archive, reactivate) include clone_status, head_sha, and clone_error fields in their JSON responses.
preconditions: hub server is running with a valid config
A workspace exists in the database with known clone_status, head_sha, and clone_error values
Valid authentication token is available

expected.all_responses: JSON object contains clone_status (string), head_sha (string or null), clone_error (string or null)

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: for each endpoint in endpoints: resp = call(endpoint); assert resp.body has key 'clone_status'; assert resp.body has key 'head_sha'; assert resp.body has key 'clone_error'; assert type(resp.body.clone_status) == string

test_cases.description: The workspaces table enforces that clone_status is one of the five valid values: pending, cloning, ready, failed, archived.
preconditions: SQLite database is initialized with the workspaces table

expected.invalid_insert: either rejected by CHECK constraint or application-level validation prevents it

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: for status in ['pending','cloning','ready','failed','archived']: insert_workspace(clone_status=status); assert no error; try: insert_workspace(clone_status='invalid_state'); assert error or application rejects it

test_cases.description: On server start, an in-memory FIFO job queue is initialized and the configured number of worker goroutines (default 4) are started to consume jobs.
preconditions: hub server is configured with workers = 4 in [workspace]
Server starts successfully
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: start_server(config_with_workers=4); enqueue_N_clone_jobs(8); observe_concurrent_processing_count(); assert max_concurrent_workers <= 4; assert all_jobs_eventually_processed == true

test_cases.description: When a clone job is picked up by a worker, it sets clone_status to 'cloning', creates the workspace directory, and performs a shallow clone (Depth=1) into <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/.
preconditions: hub server is running with a valid WORKSPACE_ROOT
A workspace record exists with clone_status = 'pending'
A valid git repository URL is accessible
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: enqueue_clone_job(slug='test-ws', git_url='https://github.com/example/repo.git'); wait_for_status_change(slug='test-ws', from='pending', to='cloning'); assert dir_exists(WORKSPACE_ROOT + '/test-ws') == true; wait_for_status_change(slug='test-ws', from='cloning', to='ready'); assert dir_exists(WORKSPACE_ROOT + '/test-ws/trunk') == true; git_log = run_git(['log', '--oneline'], cwd=WORKSPACE_ROOT+'/test-ws/trunk'); assert len(git_log) == 1

test_cases.description: On successful clone, the worker sets clone_status to 'ready', records the HEAD commit SHA in head_sha, and clears clone_error to NULL.
preconditions: hub server is running
A clone job has been enqueued for a valid git repository
PlainCloneContext completes successfully
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: enqueue_clone_job(slug='test-ws-success', git_url=valid_url); wait_for_clone_complete(slug='test-ws-success'); ws = db.query('SELECT clone_status, head_sha, clone_error FROM workspaces WHERE slug = ?', 'test-ws-success'); assert ws.clone_status == 'ready'; assert ws.head_sha != null; assert len(ws.head_sha) == 40; assert ws.clone_error == null

test_cases.description: When PlainCloneContext returns a non-nil error, the worker sets clone_status to 'failed', records the error message in clone_error, and removes any partially created workspace directory.
preconditions: hub server is running
A clone job is enqueued with an invalid or unreachable git URL

expected.clone_error: non-null string containing the error message

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: enqueue_clone_job(slug='test-ws-fail', git_url='https://invalid.example.com/nonexistent.git'); wait_for_clone_complete(slug='test-ws-fail'); ws = db.query('SELECT clone_status, clone_error FROM workspaces WHERE slug = ?', 'test-ws-fail'); assert ws.clone_status == 'failed'; assert ws.clone_error != null; assert len(ws.clone_error) > 0; assert dir_exists(WORKSPACE_ROOT + '/test-ws-fail') == false

test_cases.description: When the workspace directory already exists under WORKSPACE_ROOT, the clone job skips PlainCloneContext and sets clone_status to 'ready' directly.
preconditions: hub server is running
The workspace directory <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/ already exists on disk
A clone job is enqueued for that workspace
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: create_dir(WORKSPACE_ROOT + '/pre-existing-ws'); enqueue_clone_job(slug='pre-existing-ws', git_url=any_url); wait_for_clone_complete(slug='pre-existing-ws'); ws = db.query('SELECT clone_status FROM workspaces WHERE slug = ?', 'pre-existing-ws'); assert ws.clone_status == 'ready'; assert PlainCloneContext_was_not_called()

test_cases.description: When branch is non-null on the workspace record, the clone job sets SingleBranch=true and ReferenceName=NewBranchReferenceName(branch) in CloneOptions.
preconditions: hub server is running
A workspace record exists with branch = 'feature/my-branch'
A clone job is enqueued for that workspace
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: captured_opts = capture_clone_options(); enqueue_clone_job(slug='test-ws-branch', git_url=valid_url, branch='feature/my-branch'); wait_for_clone_complete(slug='test-ws-branch'); assert captured_opts.SingleBranch == true; assert captured_opts.ReferenceName == 'refs/heads/feature/my-branch'

test_cases.description: When branch is null on the workspace record, the clone job omits ReferenceName from CloneOptions to clone the remote's default branch.
preconditions: hub server is running
A workspace record exists with branch = NULL
A clone job is enqueued for that workspace
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: captured_opts = capture_clone_options(); enqueue_clone_job(slug='test-ws-default-branch', git_url=valid_url, branch=null); wait_for_clone_complete(slug='test-ws-default-branch'); assert captured_opts.ReferenceName == '' or captured_opts.ReferenceName == zero_value

test_cases.description: POST /api/v1/workspaces returns HTTP 201 immediately with clone_status='pending', head_sha=null, clone_error=null without waiting for the clone to complete.
preconditions: hub server is running
Valid authentication token is available
Job queue workers are running
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: start_time = now(); resp = http_post('/api/v1/workspaces', {git_url: 'https://github.com/example/repo.git', display_name: 'Test Workspace'}); elapsed = now() - start_time; assert resp.status == 201; assert resp.body.clone_status == 'pending'; assert resp.body.head_sha == null; assert resp.body.clone_error == null; assert elapsed < 2_seconds

test_cases.description: Archiving a workspace with clone_status='ready' pushes to origin, records head_sha, deletes the workspace directory, and returns HTTP 200 with status='archived' and clone_status='archived'.
preconditions: hub server is running
A workspace exists with clone_status = 'ready' and a local clone at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/
The upstream remote is accessible and accepts pushes
Valid authentication token for the workspace owner is available
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = http_post('/api/v1/workspaces/ready-ws/archive'); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.body.status == 'archived'; assert resp.body.clone_status == 'archived'; assert resp.body.head_sha != null; assert len(resp.body.head_sha) == 40; assert dir_exists(WORKSPACE_ROOT + '/ready-ws') == false

test_cases.description: Archiving a workspace with clone_status='pending' or 'failed' cleans up any partial directory, sets clone_status='archived' and status='archived' without attempting a git push, and returns HTTP 200.
preconditions: hub server is running
A workspace exists with clone_status = 'pending' or 'failed'
Valid authentication token for the workspace owner is available
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = http_post('/api/v1/workspaces/pending-ws/archive'); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.body.status == 'archived'; assert resp.body.clone_status == 'archived'; assert git_push_was_not_called()

test_cases.description: Archiving a workspace with clone_status='cloning' returns HTTP 409 with message 'clone in progress; try again after it completes'.
preconditions: hub server is running
A workspace exists with clone_status = 'cloning' (clone is in progress)
Valid authentication token for the workspace owner is available

expected.body.message: clone in progress; try again after it completes

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: set_workspace_clone_status(slug='cloning-ws', status='cloning'); resp = http_post('/api/v1/workspaces/cloning-ws/archive'); assert resp.status == 409; assert resp.body.message == 'clone in progress; try again after it completes' or resp.body.error contains 'clone in progress'

test_cases.description: When repo.Push returns an error other than NoErrAlreadyUpToDate during archive, the handler returns HTTP 500 and leaves workspace status and clone_status unchanged.
preconditions: hub server is running
A workspace exists with clone_status = 'ready'
The upstream remote is configured to reject pushes (e.g., read-only or network error)

expected.body: JSON error body containing push error message

test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mock_push_to_return_error('push rejected'); resp = http_post('/api/v1/workspaces/push-fail-ws/archive'); assert resp.status == 500; assert resp.body.error != null; ws = db.query('SELECT status, clone_status FROM workspaces WHERE slug = ?', 'push-fail-ws'); assert ws.status == 'active'; assert ws.clone_status == 'ready'; assert dir_exists(WORKSPACE_ROOT + '/push-fail-ws') == true

test_cases.description: When repo.Push returns NoErrAlreadyUpToDate during archive, the handler treats it as success and proceeds to record head_sha, delete the directory, and return HTTP 200.
preconditions: hub server is running
A workspace exists with clone_status = 'ready'
The upstream remote is already up-to-date (no new local commits)
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: mock_push_to_return(NoErrAlreadyUpToDate); resp = http_post('/api/v1/workspaces/already-up-to-date-ws/archive'); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.body.status == 'archived'; assert resp.body.clone_status == 'archived'; assert resp.body.head_sha != null; assert dir_exists(WORKSPACE_ROOT + '/already-up-to-date-ws') == false

test_cases.description: POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/reactivate sets status='active', clone_status='pending', clears clone_error, enqueues a reclone job, and returns HTTP 200 immediately.
preconditions: hub server is running
A workspace exists with status = 'archived' and clone_status = 'archived'
Valid authentication token for the workspace owner is available
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = http_post('/api/v1/workspaces/archived-ws/reactivate'); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.body.status == 'active'; assert resp.body.clone_status == 'pending'; assert resp.body.clone_error == null; assert reclone_job_was_enqueued(slug='archived-ws') == true

test_cases.description: DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/:slug checks for and deletes the workspace directory if it exists, then deletes the database row, returning HTTP 204; logs a warning if directory deletion fails but still deletes the row.
preconditions: hub server is running
A workspace exists with status = 'archived'
The workspace directory exists under WORKSPACE_ROOT
Valid authentication token for the workspace owner is available
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: create_dir(WORKSPACE_ROOT + '/archived-ws-to-delete'); resp = http_delete('/api/v1/workspaces/archived-ws-to-delete'); assert resp.status == 204; assert dir_exists(WORKSPACE_ROOT + '/archived-ws-to-delete') == false; ws = db.query('SELECT * FROM workspaces WHERE slug = ?', 'archived-ws-to-delete'); assert ws == null

test_cases.description: The clone_status state machine enforces all valid transitions: pending→cloning, cloning→ready, cloning→failed, ready→archived, pending→archived, failed→archived, archived→pending.
preconditions: hub server is running with a SQLite database
Workspace records exist in each valid clone_status state
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: for [from, to] in valid_transitions: set_clone_status(slug, from); trigger_transition(slug, to); assert get_clone_status(slug) == to; for [from, to] in invalid_transitions: set_clone_status(slug, from); result = trigger_transition(slug, to); assert result.error != null

test_cases.description: The only way to transition clone_status from 'archived' to 'pending' is via the reactivate endpoint.
preconditions: hub server is running
A workspace exists with clone_status = 'archived'
Valid authentication token is available
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: set_workspace(slug='archived-ws', clone_status='archived', status='archived'); resp = http_post('/api/v1/workspaces/archived-ws/reactivate'); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.body.clone_status == 'pending'; ws = db.query('SELECT clone_status FROM workspaces WHERE slug = ?', 'archived-ws'); assert ws.clone_status == 'pending'

property_tests.description: For any workspace record in the database, clone_status is always one of the five valid values: pending, cloning, ready, failed, archived.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample all workspace records from the SQLite database after any sequence of create, archive, reactivate, and delete operations; also generate random workspace records via table-driven tests covering all state transitions
property_tests.invariant_check: for each workspace in db.query('SELECT clone_status FROM workspaces'): assert workspace.clone_status in {'pending', 'cloning', 'ready', 'failed', 'archived'}

property_tests.description: For any workspace record, head_sha is non-null if and only if clone_status is 'ready' or clone_status is 'archived' (following a successful clone).
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample all workspace records from the SQLite database after running through create, clone, archive, and reactivate operations; use table-driven tests covering all clone_status values
property_tests.invariant_check: for each workspace in db.query('SELECT clone_status, head_sha FROM workspaces'): if workspace.clone_status in {'ready', 'archived'} and workspace_had_successful_clone: assert workspace.head_sha != null; if workspace.clone_status in {'pending', 'cloning', 'failed'}: assert workspace.head_sha == null

property_tests.description: For any workspace record, clone_error is null whenever clone_status is pending, cloning, ready, or archived.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Sample all workspace records from the SQLite database after any sequence of operations; use table-driven tests that exercise each non-failed clone_status value
property_tests.invariant_check: for each workspace in db.query('SELECT clone_status, clone_error FROM workspaces'): if workspace.clone_status in {'pending', 'cloning', 'ready', 'archived'}: assert workspace.clone_error == null

property_tests.description: For any workspace slug, the workspace directory exists on disk if and only if clone_status is 'cloning' or 'ready'; it does not exist when clone_status is pending, failed, or archived.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: After each state transition (clone start, clone success, clone failure, archive, reactivate), check filesystem state against database clone_status for a set of 10 test workspaces with varying slugs
property_tests.invariant_check: for each workspace in db.query('SELECT slug, clone_status FROM workspaces'): dir_path = WORKSPACE_ROOT + '/' + workspace.slug; if workspace.clone_status in {'cloning', 'ready'}: assert dir_exists(dir_path) == true; if workspace.clone_status in {'pending', 'failed', 'archived'}: assert dir_exists(dir_path) == false

property_tests.description: For any config.toml with workers=0 or omitted [workspace] section, Workspace.Workers is always >= 1 after Load() returns.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate config.toml variants with workers values of 0, -1, omitted, and various positive integers; call Load() for each and check the resulting Workers value
property_tests.invariant_check: for workers_value in [0, -1, null, 1, 2, 4, 8, 100]: write_config(workers=workers_value); cfg, err = Load(); assert err == nil; assert cfg.Workspace.Workers >= 1; if workers_value <= 0 or workers_value == null: assert cfg.Workspace.Workers == 4

property_tests.description: For any workspace with clone_status='cloning', POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/archive always returns HTTP 409 and never modifies clone_status or status.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Create 5 workspaces, force each to clone_status='cloning' via direct database update, then call the archive endpoint for each; verify response and database state
property_tests.invariant_check: for each workspace with clone_status='cloning': resp = http_post('/api/v1/workspaces/' + slug + '/archive'); assert resp.status == 409; ws = db.query('SELECT clone_status, status FROM workspaces WHERE slug = ?', slug); assert ws.clone_status == 'cloning'; assert ws.status == 'active'

property_tests.description: For any clone job or reclone job, CloneOptions.Depth is always set to 1; deep clones are never performed.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Intercept all PlainCloneContext calls across 10 clone and reclone operations with varying git URLs and branches; capture and inspect CloneOptions for each call
property_tests.invariant_check: captured_calls = intercept_plain_clone_context_calls(); for each call in captured_calls: assert call.options.Depth == 1

property_tests.description: For any workspace record with a non-null head_sha, head_sha matches the pattern [0-9a-f]{40}.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Query all workspace records with non-null head_sha from the SQLite database after running 10 successful clone and archive operations; validate each head_sha value
property_tests.invariant_check: for each workspace in db.query('SELECT head_sha FROM workspaces WHERE head_sha IS NOT NULL'): assert len(workspace.head_sha) == 40; assert workspace.head_sha matches regex '^[0-9a-f]{40}$'

config.toml contains [workspace] path = "myworkspace" (bare name, no slash)

edge_case_tests.description: When workspace path is empty and XDG_DATA_HOME is set, Load() defaults Workspace.Path to '$XDG_DATA_HOME/workspaces'.
preconditions: XDG_DATA_HOME environment variable is set to '/home/user/.local/share'
config.toml contains [workspace] path = "" or omits path
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: set_env('XDG_DATA_HOME', '/home/user/.local/share'); write_config('[workspace]\npath = ""'); cfg, err = Load(); assert err == nil; assert cfg.Workspace.Path == '/home/user/.local/share/workspaces'

edge_case_tests.description: When workers is set to 0 in config.toml, Load() overrides it to 4.

edge_case_tests.description: When WORKSPACE_ROOT already exists on server boot, the server proceeds without error and does not modify the existing directory.

hub server is configured to use that directory

preconditions: None of the parent directories in the WORKSPACE_ROOT path exist
The process has write permission to the base directory

edge_case_tests.description: After a successful clone, GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug returns clone_status='ready' and a non-null head_sha containing a 40-character hex SHA.
preconditions: hub server is running
A workspace exists whose clone has completed successfully
Valid authentication token is available
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: wait_for_clone_status(slug='ready-workspace', status='ready'); resp = http_get('/api/v1/workspaces/ready-workspace'); assert resp.body.clone_status == 'ready'; assert resp.body.head_sha != null; assert len(resp.body.head_sha) == 40; assert resp.body.head_sha matches regex '[0-9a-f]{40}'; assert resp.body.clone_error == null

edge_case_tests.description: On graceful shutdown, the server cancels the root context, causing in-progress PlainCloneContext calls to be interrupted and pending jobs to be discarded.
preconditions: hub server is running with a slow or hanging clone in progress
Additional jobs are pending in the queue
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: enqueue_slow_clone_job(slug='slow-ws'); enqueue_pending_job(slug='pending-ws'); wait_for_clone_status(slug='slow-ws', status='cloning'); send_signal(server, SIGTERM); wait_for_server_exit(); ws_slow = db.query('SELECT clone_status FROM workspaces WHERE slug = ?', 'slow-ws'); assert ws_slow.clone_status == 'failed'; ws_pending = db.query('SELECT clone_status FROM workspaces WHERE slug = ?', 'pending-ws'); assert ws_pending.clone_status == 'pending'

edge_case_tests.description: When a clone is interrupted by context cancellation (server shutdown), the worker sets clone_status to 'failed' and removes any partially created workspace directory.
preconditions: hub server is running
A clone is in progress (clone_status = 'cloning')
The server's root context is cancelled
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: enqueue_slow_clone_job(slug='interrupted-ws'); wait_for_clone_status(slug='interrupted-ws', status='cloning'); cancel_server_context(); wait_for_worker_to_finish(); ws = db.query('SELECT clone_status FROM workspaces WHERE slug = ?', 'interrupted-ws'); assert ws.clone_status == 'failed'; assert dir_exists(WORKSPACE_ROOT + '/interrupted-ws') == false

edge_case_tests.description: When the workspace directory was partially created before a clone error, the worker removes it using os.RemoveAll before setting clone_status to 'failed'.
preconditions: hub server is running
A clone job is in progress and the workspace directory was partially created
PlainCloneContext returns an error mid-clone
edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: simulate_partial_clone_failure(slug='partial-ws'); wait_for_clone_complete(slug='partial-ws'); assert dir_exists(WORKSPACE_ROOT + '/partial-ws') == false; ws = db.query('SELECT clone_status FROM workspaces WHERE slug = ?', 'partial-ws'); assert ws.clone_status == 'failed'

edge_case_tests.description: When git_url is unreachable, the worker sets clone_status to 'failed' and records the network error message in clone_error without retrying.
preconditions: hub server is running
A clone job is enqueued with an unreachable git URL

expected.clone_error: non-null string containing network or remote error

edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: enqueue_clone_job(slug='unreachable-ws', git_url='https://unreachable.example.invalid/repo.git'); wait_for_clone_complete(slug='unreachable-ws'); ws = db.query('SELECT clone_status, clone_error FROM workspaces WHERE slug = ?', 'unreachable-ws'); assert ws.clone_status == 'failed'; assert ws.clone_error != null; assert clone_attempt_count(slug='unreachable-ws') == 1

edge_case_tests.description: When the specified branch does not exist on the remote, PlainCloneContext returns an error and the worker sets clone_status to 'failed' with the branch-not-found error in clone_error.
preconditions: hub server is running
A clone job is enqueued with a valid git URL but a non-existent branch

smoke_tests.description: Happy path: workspace is created via POST /api/v1/workspaces, returns HTTP 201 with clone_status='pending', and the job queue worker clones the repository and sets clone_status='ready' with a valid head_sha.
smoke_tests.trigger: Developer calls POST /api/v1/workspaces with a valid git_url and optional branch
expected_effects: POST /api/v1/workspaces returns HTTP 201 with clone_status='pending', head_sha=null, clone_error=null
A clone job is enqueued on the in-memory job queue
The workspace record in SQLite transitions from clone_status='pending' to 'cloning' to 'ready'
The directory <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/ is created on disk
head_sha is set to a 40-character hex SHA in the database
GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug returns clone_status='ready' and a valid head_sha

smoke_tests.description: Happy path: archiving a workspace with clone_status='ready' pushes local commits to upstream, records head_sha, deletes the local clone directory, and returns HTTP 200 with status='archived'.
smoke_tests.trigger: Developer calls POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/archive on a workspace with clone_status='ready'
expected_effects: PlainOpen opens the repository at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/
repo.Push is called with RemoteName='origin'
head_sha is recorded in the database from repo.Head().Hash().String()
The workspace directory <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/ is deleted from disk
clone_status is set to 'archived' in the database
status is set to 'archived' in the database
HTTP 200 is returned with status='archived', clone_status='archived', and the recorded head_sha

smoke_tests.description: Happy path: reactivating an archived workspace sets status='active', clone_status='pending', enqueues a reclone job, and the worker re-clones the repository setting clone_status='ready'.
smoke_tests.trigger: Developer calls POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/reactivate on an archived workspace
expected_effects: HTTP 200 is returned immediately with status='active', clone_status='pending', clone_error=null
A reclone job is enqueued on the in-memory job queue
The workspace record transitions from clone_status='pending' to 'cloning' to 'ready'
The directory <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/ is re-created on disk
head_sha is updated to the new HEAD SHA in the database

smoke_tests.description: Happy path: deleting an archived workspace removes any remaining workspace directory and deletes the database row, returning HTTP 204.
smoke_tests.trigger: Developer calls DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/:slug on an archived workspace
expected_effects: The workspace directory <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/ is checked for existence
If the directory exists, it is deleted using os.RemoveAll
The workspace database row is deleted from SQLite
HTTP 204 is returned

smoke_tests.description: End-to-end full workspace lifecycle: create → clone → archive → reactivate → reclone → archive → delete, verifying correct state transitions and HTTP responses at each step.
smoke_tests.trigger: Developer executes the full workspace lifecycle sequence via the API
mockable: git remote (PlainCloneContext and repo.Push network calls)
expected_effects: POST /api/v1/workspaces returns HTTP 201 with clone_status='pending'
Worker clones repository; clone_status transitions to 'ready' with valid head_sha
GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug returns clone_status='ready' and valid head_sha
POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/archive returns HTTP 200 with clone_status='archived'; directory deleted
POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/reactivate returns HTTP 200 with clone_status='pending'
Worker re-clones; clone_status transitions to 'ready'
Second archive returns HTTP 200 with clone_status='archived'
DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/:slug returns HTTP 204; database row deleted; no directory remains

smoke_tests.description: Failure path: workspace is created with an invalid git URL, returns HTTP 201 with clone_status='pending', and the worker sets clone_status='failed' with the error in clone_error after PlainCloneContext fails.
smoke_tests.trigger: Developer calls POST /api/v1/workspaces with an invalid or unreachable git_url
mockable: git remote (PlainCloneContext network call — returns error)
expected_effects: POST /api/v1/workspaces returns HTTP 201 with clone_status='pending'
Worker picks up the clone job and sets clone_status='cloning'
PlainCloneContext returns a non-nil error
Any partially created workspace directory is removed from disk
clone_status is set to 'failed' in the database
clone_error contains the error message in the database
GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug returns clone_status='failed' and a non-null clone_error
